channel.description: The FOX News Rundown is your daily news podcast for making sense of the big issues directly impacting your life. Go beyond the headlines every morning and join some of FOX News’ most exceptional journalists—including FOX News Channel reporters Peter Doocy, Aishah Hasnie, Bill Melugin, Alex Hogan, Lucas Tomlinson and Jacqui Heinrich and FOX News Radio reporters Dave Anthony, Jessica Rosenthal, Lisa Brady, and Gurnal Scott - as they tap into the global reporting resources of FOX News and get unparalleled political analysis and exclusive insight from top newsmakers. The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: The 'Good News' For The GOP As Election Day Nears
item.description:
With just weeks until the midterm elections, both parties continue fighting for control of Congress as Republicans face historical headwinds and a shrinking House majority. While Democrats appear to have momentum, Republicans are betting on strong candidates and President Trump’s campaign blitz to help them hold their ground. White House correspondent Aishah Hasnie speaks with Republican strategist and co founder of South and Hill Strategies Colin Reed to break down the battle for the House and Senate, including whether the president’s rallies are helping vulnerable Republicans.
As mortgage rates spike alongside multi-decade highs in the 10-year Treasury yield, buyers and sellers are navigating a challenging housing market shaped by high borrowing costs and record-high home prices. Wall Street Journal housing reporter Nicholas Miller joins to discuss the situation—including low inventory, seller credits for rate buy-downs, the risks of adjustable-rate mortgages, and rising construction costs for builders—explaining why high interest rates are likely to persist.
PLUS, commentary by Jason Chaffetz, FOX News contributor and the host of the Jason In The House podcast on FOX News Radio.

item.title: Pope Leo Recovering After Lung Cancer Surgery
item.description:
The Vatican announced Pope Leo XIV has lung cancer after he underwent successful surgery to remove a part of his lung. According to the Vatican, the Pope returned to his room and asked for dinner after the operation. The surgery was about 90 minutes and confirmed a diagnosis of pulmonary adenocarcinoma. The Vatican says that right now there is no talk of the Pope needing chemotherapy and additional biopsy results are expected in the coming days.
FOX’s Jonathan Savage speaks with FOX's Lauren Green, chief religion correspondent for FOX, who walks us through the timeline of the last few days and what may come next for Pope Leo.

item.title: As ICE Debate Heats Up, Angel Families Demand Their Voice Be Heard Too
item.description:
As the Trump administration continues its nationwide immigration crackdown, the debate over border security and ICE enforcement is drawing renewed scrutiny—especially after an illegal migrant was shot during an encounter with federal agents last week in New York. FOX News congressional correspondent Bill Melugin speaks with Joe Abraham, executive director of the Department of Homeland Security’s VOICE office, about the pushback ICE agents are receiving nationwide, why he is advocating for support for victims of crimes committed by illegal immigrants, and his concerns over how those cases are addressed in the national conversation. Abraham, who lost his daughter Katie in a fatal hit-and-run involving an intoxicated illegal immigrant, also discusses his personal experience and the challenges facing other families seeking answers and accountability.
While the latest FOX News Power Rankings say the House is likely in Democrats' hands, there are several tight races that could determine who wins the majority this November. One key toss-up race is Michigan's 7th Congressional District. Incumbent Republican Congressman Tom Barrett joins the Rundown to discuss his strategy to get re-elected, his military background, and why he believes his platform resonates with Michigan families. He outlines his legislative proposals and addresses voters' top concerns, including healthcare costs, housing affordability, gas, and groceries.
PLUS, commentary by Gregg Jarrett, FOX News legal analyst and commentator.

item.title: Families of 9/11 Victims Gain Momentum for Lawsuit Against Saudi Arabia

item.itunes:author: FOX News Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Last week, the Second Circuit Court of Appeals in New York City heard oral arguments in a civil lawsuit brought by families and survivors of September 11th  terrorist attacks. The families allege Saudi government officials provided assistance to the 9/11 hijackers. The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia denies any involvement. Last year a lower court rejected Saudi Arabia’s efforts to have the case dismissed. 


FOX’s Tonya J. Powers speaks with Brett Eagleson, president of '9/11 Justice', who says he is confident that the three judge panel will decide to allow the lawsuit to proceed.

item.title: "What Kind of Country Are We?" | Brian Kilmeade on the 2026 Midterms and "Uniting the States"
item.description:
With just three weeks until the 2026 midterms, both parties are making their final pushes. President Trump continues his cross-country campaign blitz in key battleground states, while House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries frames the upcoming vote as a pivotal "Judgment Day" for the nation. Co-host of FOX & Friends and host of The Brian Kilmeade Show on FOX News Radio Brian Kilmeade, joins the Rundown to analyze the tightening Senate races and how energy policies are shaping voter choices. He also discusses his new book, Uniting the States: Six Crucial Moments That Forged the American Miracle.
Can America actually afford Medicare for all, or is universal healthcare an impossible economic pipe dream? FOX Business contributor Lou Basenese joins the Rundown to unpack the massive price tag behind universal healthcare proposals, and to explain why confiscating billionaire wealth and corporate profits still won't cover the bill.
PLUS, commentary by Ted Jenkin, President of Exit Stage Left Advisors and Host of The Red, White & Green Show.

item.title: Targeting the Kingdom: How El Chapo Was Caught & the Fight Against Fentanyl
item.description: Fentanyl overdose deaths are seeing a significant drop, but is the battle against cartels really turning the tide? A former federal special agent joins the Rundown to explain why targeting leadership alone acts like "whack-a-mole" unless financial communication networks are completely dismantled.FOX's Jessica Rosenthal speaks with Retired Special Agent with Homeland Security Investigations Eric Balliet to analyze the latest overdose statistics, effectiveness of border strategies and what it takes to disrupt transnational criminal networks.
